programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face
programme.desc: A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands. When investigators learned she'd been dead for 18 months, they knew it would be difficult to find out who she was, let alone who killed her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Time Bomb
programme.desc: In 1978, Lt. Joe Kenda is new to the CSPD, and gets more than he bargains for when a local bank is the target of a massive explosion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Too Young To Die
programme.desc: A frenzied ambush at a hamburger stand leaves a 16-year old boy dead. Lt. Joe Kenda must cut through a mountain of rumor and innuendo in order to zero in on his prime suspect.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Haunts Me
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be is shot and left for dead. To catch her assailant, Kenda must elicit a death-bed confession from the victim herself.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Razor’s Edge
programme.desc: When police find 24-year-old Patrick Ray with a gunshot to the temple, the scene has all the telltale signs of suicide. But Lt. Joe Kenda's instinct says otherwise.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Manifesto
programme.desc: A cabin on the slopes of Pikes Peak catches fire, and a young sheriff’s deputy is posted to guard the scene overnight--then he’s found dead in his patrol car the next morning.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Emissiaries
programme.desc: NASA and others are developing new innovative propulsion systems, Ion thrusters, solar sails and the science fiction 'Warp drive' is not as far away as once thought.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Danger, Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: The threat of an asteroid strike is a very real danger in our solar system, mankind is now in a position to defend the planet from such an eventuality.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: Wives With Knives: Addicted To Love
programme.desc: After years of failed relationships, Misty reconnects with her soulmate, Mark. But their relationship is a roller coaster ride of drugs, sex, and violence.

programme.title: Wives With Knives: Perils of Paranoia
programme.desc: A bored teenager looking for trouble finds it after becoming pregnant. Heather finds stability with Terri, until she decides she needs more attention and loyalty, then things take a deadly turn.

programme.title: Wives With Knives: Southern Spirit
programme.desc: When tragedy strikes, Paula goes down a path of pain and despair. She gets her life back on track after years of hard work, then a demon lurking inside awakens turning Paula's new life upside down.

programme.title: Wives With Knives: Not My Cup Of Tea
programme.desc: After a tough childhood, Missey Martinez finds stability in the world of stripping, then she starts dating her high school crush and makes a high-stakes gamble that ends in violence.

programme.title: Wives With Knives: Shear Rage
programme.desc: Living the fast life, Trena Archie gets involved with countless powerful men, then, after being exploited one too many times, Archie gets her revenge -- with a knife.

programme.title: Wives With Knives: Poetic Justice
programme.desc: After surviving a difficult childhood, Laura Lewis becomes involved with a cheater who beats her and fights back with a knife.

programme.title: iCarly: Missekonkurransen
programme.desc: Sam avslører overfor Carly og Freddie at hun deltok i skjønnhetskonkurranser som liten. Da hun finner ut at hennes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om å stille opp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: Etter at Sam plutselig må i fengsel, lover Carly og Freddie dyrt og hellig å ikke avlyse nettshowet ettersom faren hennes skal se det. Carly ber Spencer om hjelp, men det blir vanskelig, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: En eksentrisk millionær ber Carly og vennene hennes om å sende det første nettshowet fra det ytre rom, så de må prøves ut for en romreise. Imens besøker en merkelig liten pike Spencer hjemme i leiligheten.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie flytter ut
programme.desc: Freddie bestemmer seg for å flytte ut av leiligheten sin etter at moren hans har gjort ham flau. Carly, Sam og Freddie starter et firma og spesialiserer seg på bilder av kjæledyr.

programme.title: iCarly: iBeat the Heat
programme.desc: Når en hetebølge rammer Seattle og strømmen går, kommer Spencer til unnsetning med et norsk klimaanlegg.

programme.title: iCarly: Tabber
programme.desc: De medvirkende introduserer bloopers og bortklipte scener fra serien.

programme.title: iCarly: Rommet brenner
programme.desc: Spencer prøver å overraske Carly på bursdagen hennes, men ender opp med å brenne ned rommet hennes. Men når forsikringsselskapet gir ham en stor sjekk, har han sjansen til å gjøre det godt igjen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja
programme.desc: Etter at en iCarly fan frir til kjæresten på nettshowet, blir gjengen nesten tvunget til å gå i bryllupet. Men når bruden får kalde føtter, må Carly komme til unnsetning.

programme.title: iCarly: T-skjortesalg
programme.desc: Gjengen begynner å selge Penny-skjorter, og når salget går susende, rekrutterer Sam barn fra 4. klasse for å bidra til å lage t-skjorter. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Etterdønningene etter Jennas krangel med vennene gjør at hun går ut en kveld. Men det som skulle bli en kveld for å lette på trykket blir en kveld hun må reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide at Jenna kommer inn på rett spor igjen, men hun har forårsaket mer skade for sine nærmeste enn det som kan rettes opp med litt PR. Vil de tilgi henne, eller må hun ta i bruk drastiske midler?

programme.title: Awkward
programme.desc: Jenna og jentene er venner igjen og Jenna tror at hun er klar for å gjenoppta kjærlighetsaffæren med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håper at hvis hun retter opp sine feil ved å hjelpe Val med å få tilbake jobben sin, vil universet belønne henne med å sørge for at hun og Matty blir sammen igjen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna utfordres til å sette spørsmålstegn ved hvem hun vil være i denne episke sesongfinalen.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: En pinlig stund venter når vi tar en titt på de beste klippene fra 'Awkward' der skuespillerne selv kommenterer de morsomste replikkene, de saftigste forholdene og mye mer fra deres favorittepisoder av Awkward.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: Sisteårsrampestreker lager kaos mens Jennas forsett om å slutte å tenke på Matty blir satt på prøve når hun overhører en forstyrrende hemmelighet.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna forårsaker en ulykke på skolen som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvensene av konfrontasjonen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyter litt popularitet, sliter Matty med å bli holdt utenfor. Samtidig prøver Jake seg på den nye jenta, og Ally holder en sexleke-fest.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This episode of Unplugged features Canadian star Alanis Morissette, shot from the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Mando Diao MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Med gjesteartister som Ane Brun, Kristofer Greczula og Veera Pyykkö inntar Mando Diao MTV Unplugged-scenen. Pluto TV byr på en nedstrippet og intim konsert med Mando Diao fra deres nye album «Efter Solnedgången».

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Lenny Kravitz unplugged.

programme.title: Another Period: Annulment
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrices ekteskap blir annullert, samt Lillian og Victor krangler om deres dyrebare 'Butternut' - rommet. Beatrice hjelper Albert med å komme over øksefobien, og Garfield krangler med en tvilsom ny tjener.

programme.title: Another Period: The Prince And The Pauper
programme.desc: Huset Commodore inviterer en prins til Bellacourt Manor. Det starter en intens rivalisering mellom Lillian og Beatrice. Peepers gir prinsens tjener motbør angående korrekte butler-metoder, og Hamishs cellekamerat prøver å lære ham å lese.

programme.title: Another Period: Trial of the Century
programme.desc: Hamish står for retten for mordet på Scoops LaPue. Lillian prøver å bruke saken for å skape blest om egen person, og Peepers nyter en siste dag i frihet før han prøver å påta seg skylden for forbrytelsen.

programme.title: Detroiters: Dream Cruise
programme.desc: Når de ansatte truer med å slutte på grunn av manglende helseforsikring, forsøker Tim og Sam å samle inn pengene de skylder fra tidligere jobber. Deres innsats forvanskes av Detroits årlige 'Dream Cruise'-bilshow. Gjest er Cecily Strong.

programme.title: Detroiters: Husky Boys
programme.desc: Tims far - 'Big Hank' - kommer uventet tilbake fra galehuset under mistenkelige forhold. Tim og Sam sliter med en å skape et slagord for en varehus-reklame som henvender seg til store, sterke karer.

programme.title: Detroiters: Quick Rick Mahorn in Dearborn
programme.desc: Tim og Sam oppdager at Chrysler-sjefen de kjørte over har hatt det forferdelig siden. Etter å ha vært med i en av reklamene, får Piston-legenden Rick Mahorn skuespillerambisjoner. Gjester er Jason Sudeikis, Rick Mahorn og Richard Karn.

programme.title: Workaholics: Dry Guys
programme.desc: Gutta våkner opp i deres vrakede huset etter en natt med vill festing. De har forferdelig bakrus og bestemmer seg for å holde seg edru i en uke, men Adam er ikke helt med på idéen.

programme.title: Workaholics: Temp-Tress
programme.desc: Det er en ny deilig vikar på TelAmericorp. Adam, Anders og Blake finner det svært vanskelig å konsentrere seg i hennes nærvær. Deres selvkontroll blir satt på prøve.

programme.title: Workaholics: Heist School
programme.desc: Gutta bestemmer at de som skattebetalere har rett til å eie den lokale lekeplassens dragestatue. De stiller den ut foran huset, der den blir stjålet av noen high school-elever. Gutta går undercover for å få den tilbake.

programme.title: Workaholics: 6 Hours Till Hedonism II
programme.desc: Gutta har planlagt en kul reise til Thanksgiving, men de finner ut at Blake ikke har et gyldig pass. Det er plutselig ikke så gøy når de må vente i seks timer på å få et nytt eller avlyse deres tur til Hedonism II.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Rachel Feinstein
programme.desc: Rachel Feinstein diskuterer hvor vanskelig det er å finne en mann som ikke har homofile tendenser, og sine følelser angående porno.
